title: Easy to use
text: Easy to use. My first time using such a tool to make Polish/Russian/Turkish dumplings.  I was excited to try a new cultural experience.  Whilst we enjoyed trying the new foodie experience, many great YouTube’s recipes and demos.  I was a little cautious with the finish of the tool itself: not sure of what aluminum finish should look like, but I kept thinking it had another plastic layer I needed to peel off before use?  I decided to clean it by hand and not test it via dish washer.  I hover with 3.5 stars as I am not sure what the finish should be for this tool.  Thus far, it does wash easily.  Instructions were not in English, and I am assuming it is in Russian; not an issue given access via internet.
